name: Suzanne Bergman
description: The PLACE19 programme identifies Suzanne Bergman of Kenex as demonstrating land-use classification with QGIS and free data. The planned analysis combined satellite-based land cover, slope derived from terrain data and Land Use Capability information to assess possible land uses.
